title: The Twelve Openings of the Dragon and the Victory That Makes One Virgin
description: An anatomy of the body as a twelve-gated dragon: seven sense-organs (eyes, ears, nostrils, mouth) as the upper crown of the proprium, and five lower caves (throat, breath, etc.) as the natural-rational structure of bodily appetite. The dragon is the enthumesis of the body itself — Hyle / corrupt receptivity in serpentine form. The Virgin and the Continent are defined not as bodily condition but as the soul that recognizes, fights, and prevails over this dragon.
